# Jesus Gives the Model Prayer (Matthew 6:9)

## Emotional Focus
Praying the way Jesus showed us — simple and real.

## Key KJV
“Our Father which art in heaven…” (Matthew 6:9)

## Gentle Retelling
Jesus gave us a short, beautiful prayer to help us talk to God. It reminds us He is our Father who cares about every part of our day.

## Coloring Prompt
Jesus teaching a small group of children the Lord’s Prayer with gentle smiles.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“You can pray the same prayer Jesus taught — God loves to hear it.”
